what_changed: CFPB and DOJ withdraw, as of January 12, 2026, their October 2023 Joint Statement on Fair Lending and Credit Opportunities for Noncitizen Borrowers under ECOA (88 FR 71845), stating Regulation B permits considering immigration or citizenship status (12 CFR 1002.6(a), 1002.6(b)(7), comment 2(z)-2) and that the statement's underwriting examples may have created a misimpression of limits.
rationale: Full text shows the withdrawn statement addressed evaluating credit applications and underwriting noncitizens, not any servicing activity in the test (contact, payments, collection, modification); the notice says consumers' ECOA rights are unchanged.
